views.name: ready
views.title: Before the first ball
views.caption: the first sheet, a way off: a broken-off piece of a fractured wall, a hole through the middle of it, the next ones behind

views.name: struck
views.title: A sheet being broken
views.caption: at arm’s length: pieces in the air, the holes’ shadows on the sheet behind, the ball and its own shadow

views.name: glazed
views.title: Glazed shards
views.caption: the blue ones take two blows, and always turn the ball; seen on the way to it

views.name: wide
views.title: On a wider screen
views.caption: the way is the screen’s shape: a wider sheet, of many more shards
